name: Ten-ei (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ten-ei village emblem in red: a broken ring with a stylised device of two hooked strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Ten-ei, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1972.

features.role: Ten-ei village emblem — a broken ring with a stylised device of two hooked strokes
